question: Will U.S. initial unemployment insurance claims (DOL, seasonally adjusted, week ending) for the latest weekly reading dated on or before 2024-05-15 (expected: 2024-05-11) be above 213,000, its value for the week dated 2024-04-06?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-04-15 (the week dated 2024-04-06), rounded as shown
